description: Stream Live IPTV, Video On-Demand, and Series from an Xtream-compatible server using this plugin.
name: Jellyfin Xtream
overview: Stream content from an Xtream-compatible server.

versions.changelog: Jellyfin 12.4 build of Kevinjil/Jellyfin.Xtream master (0.8.1 + fixes from January 2026) with the Jellyfin 12 support from Kevinjil/Jellyfin.Xtream#301: .NET 10, and VOD, series and catch-up playback fixed for 12.x. 0.8.3: Xtream API requests are spaced at least 500 ms apart, so the daily guide refresh no longer trips provider flood protection. 0.8.4: new 'Xtream Live TV' channel that lists the live channels by the provider's categories.
